lines.text: That joke was a low blow.

data.define: Something unfair said to hurt someone.

example.text: That joke was a low blow.

misuse.text: Don't call fair criticism a 'low blow'.
misuse.why: It may just be honest feedback.

data.l1_hook: ¡Él mencionó su error del pasado! "low blow"
